column1: # Replay R-1 river: daily discharge (GloFAS v4 through the Open-Meteo flood API) at three fixed points. time_utc is the END of the day. danger_level is NOT an official level: it is the 90th percentile of the point's own daily discharge over the baseline days 2025-05-02 to 2025-07-30 (docs/REPLAY-METHOD.md).
